paragraphs.text: Read PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX documents and OCR scans as agent tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
# dsh-doc-reader
Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools for **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)**.
The built-in `read` tool returns file text, and `web_fetch` rejects `application/pdf` — so a PDF, a
spreadsheet or a slide deck currently ends up as `curl` + `pip install pypdf` inside the session. Th
is plugin closes that gap with five typed tools that return page-, sheet- and slide-aware text, incl
uding local OCR for scans and screenshots.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does | Key parameters |
| `doc_read` | Universal reader: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT/MD/CSV/HTML; auto-detects format by magi

c bytes | `path` \| `url`, `format`, `pages`, `sheet`, `maxRows`, `maxChars` |
| `pdf_read` | PDF pa
ge by page with `--- page N/M ---` markers, title/author metadata | `path` \| `url`, `pages` (e.g. `

"1-3,7"`), `maxChars` |
| `xlsx_read` | One block per sheet, tab-separated rows, sheet by name or 1-

based index | `path` \| `url`, `sheet`, `maxRows`, `maxChars` |
| `doc_meta` | Metadata only: format
, size, PDF page count/title, DOCX props, XLSX sheets, PPTX slide count | `path` \| `url`, `format`

|
| `doc_ocr` | OCR for scanned PDFs and images (PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/TIFF/GIF), per-page confidence |
`path` \| `url`, `pages`, `langs`, `scale`, `maxChars` |
Every tool accepts a local path **or** an `http(s)` URL. Prefer `doc_meta` first for large files, th
en read the pages/sheets you need — output is capped by `maxChars` (default `60000`, hard cap `40000
ead the pages/sheets you need — output is capped by `maxChars` (default `60000`, hard cap `400000`).

## OCR
`doc_ocr` handles what pure text extraction cannot: scanned PDFs, photos and screenshots.
- Engine: **tesseract.js 7** (WebAssembly, no native OCR binary) — runs fully locally, nothing is up

loaded.
- PDF pages are rasterized with `pdf-to-img` (pdf.js + `@napi-rs/canvas`) at `scale` 2 (~200

DPI), then recognized with one shared worker.
- Fax-style **CCITT G4 and JBIG2** scans are decoded
through pdf.js wasm/JS decoders (`wasmUrl` is wired to the installed `pdfjs-dist/wasm`), so two-tone

scans rasterize instead of returning blank pages.
- Default languages: **`rus+eng`** (`langs` overr
ides, e.g. `"deu"`, `"eng"`). Order matters: with `eng+rus` tesseract reads uppercase Cyrillic as La
tin lookalikes (`ПРИВЕТ` → `NMPUBET`); Cyrillic-first keeps Latin accuracy identical (measured 94–95

% on both fixture sets).
- **First use downloads the language data** (~4 MB per language) into `~/.d
sh/cache/dsh-doc-reader/tesseract`; later calls are fast (a page takes ~0.3–1 s). For offline machin
es set `DSH_DOC_READER_OCR_LANG_PATH` to a directory containing `<lang>.traineddata` (optionally `.g

z`), and/or `DSH_DOC_READER_OCR_CACHE` for the cache location.
- At most **20 PDF pages per call**;

narrow with `pages`. Use `scale: 1` for speed, `scale: 3` for small print.
- Rotation/handwriting/lo
w-resolution scans are best-effort: tesseract has no layout magic, and confidence is reported per pa
ge so you can judge the result.

## Limits and security

- Local files: up to **50 MB**; URLs: downloaded with a **20 s timeout** and the same 50 MB cap.
- *
*Private/local hosts are refused** (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, RFC1918, `.local`, `.internal`) so the

tool cannot become an SSRF primitive. Download the file and pass a `path` instead.
- Only `http(s)`

URLs.
- PDF text extraction is text-based: scanned PDFs (images only) return `(no extractable text

on this page)` — use `doc_ocr` for those.
- DOCX conversion is handled by `mammoth`; charts, comment

s and tracked changes are not materialized as text.
- XLSX returns displayed values, not formulas; r
ows are paged with `maxRows`.

## Roadmap

- `.doc`, `.rtf`, `.odt`, `.epub` readers.
- Layout hints from OCR (word boxes, tables) and page-num

ber citations.
- Page/sheet images for vision models (`presentResult` image parts).
- Caching of par
sed documents within a session.
